proves.claim: a label below its minimum yields the top servable item carrying it, and none once every minimum is met.

queue.label-pick.minimum-yields-top.why: Label minimums must pull work to the labels that lack it.

proves.claim: a label at its maximum is never picked, and a closed milestone never fills a minimum.

queue.label-pick.maximum-and-closed.why: Maximums cap a label and a closed milestone must not count.

proves.claim: readGateQueueSettings reads the named file, not the machine home.

queue.settings.reads-named-file.why: A cell must not read machine settings on its own.

proves.claim: diagnostics pass background work only when every waiter knows the ordering.

queue.diagnostic.waiters-know-ordering.why: A waiter that ignores ordering can starve or reorder work.

proves.claim: every queue-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

queue.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.
